resources.string: LockWeb Anti-Tamper Guard prevents unauthorized changes to device settings that could disable your website blocker or adult filter.
Alerts when Anti-Tamper Guard or VPN protection is weakened
Anti-Tamper Guard is disabled. Tap to re-enable in Accessibility settings.
LockWeb Device Administrator prevents unauthorized uninstallation of the website and adult content blocker.
Disabling LockWeb Device Administrator will remove uninstall protection. Your website blocks and adult content filters may be bypassed.
VPN protection was disconnected by the system or another VPN. Tap to resume.
Device rebooted. Tap to ensure LockWeb website blocking is active.
